meta.title: Oft-told
meta.description: Keep your notes in the room in every session: point it at a folder, and it lifts a few sections in at the start. Ships with a starter folder and file, so it works out of the box.

config.memoryDir: Where your notes live. Created with a starter file on first run, so you can leave this alone; point it at a folder you already keep and the plugin only reads it.
config.sections: Which parts it should remember. Write the headings as they appear in your notes, one per line — you can list several.
config.maxChars: How much of each section to read. Longer text is cut. 600 characters is about 400 tokens, charged once per session.
config.header: The line that opens the block. It tells the model this is background, not something you said. Usually no need to change it.
config.refreshIntervalMs: How often to inject again within one session, in milliseconds. 0 means once; 60000 means at most once a minute.
config.refreshAfterMessages: Re-inject after this many messages. 0 means never. Only needed in long sessions where the block gets compacted away.
config.workspaceRelative: What a relative path is resolved against. On: this session's folder. Off: the folder the process started in. Usually no need to change it.

diagnosticsHint: The plugin never interrupts a session to report a problem, so 'nothing was injected' has no warning of its own — it only leaves a record here. The file holds paths and per-injection outcomes, never the text of your notes, so it is safe to paste into an issue.
